sentence: The government and NHS England say the framework is a 10-year strategic vision to reduce premature deaths from heart disease and stroke in England.
It sets out 12 priorities for the next three years.
The government says the priorities include finding people at risk of cardiovascular disease, blood pressure and cholesterol treatment targets, stroke care and rehabilitation.
